name: drydock
description: Per-host daemon that owns AI-CLI PTYs, plus a web shell that attaches to them. PoC.
comment: scripts/up.mts runs under BUN and scripts/build-native.mjs under NODE, and neither is interchangeable. build-native must be plain JavaScript on plain node: it is the postinstall, so it runs while the dependency tree is still in flux, and `node --import tsx` does not resolve from this directory at all (tsx is a daemon-workspace dependency, so there is no node_modules/.bin/tsx here). up only orchestrates and loads no native addon, so bun runs its TypeScript directly (DRY-80).

scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it drydock-db psql -U drydock -d drydock
